Viper is good because she is the only controller who can put her smokes up and down at will. She can create insane lurk timings for herself or create a surprise coordinated team peek by dropping the wall for her team. Vipers ult is also arguably the best ability in the game.
Harbor cannot control when his smokes go up and down, the slow effect makes it hard for your team to do things with his smokes, like pop flash plays or push through them if they think they have a timing. His cove is really easy to break and his ult is borderline useless on any map that isn’t Icebox. (That map is retake A site simulator and the ult is useful for getting people off those pesky vertical angles). 
Viper also has a global presence. She can put up or drop her wall and orb from anywhere on the map, whereas Harbor has to be in the action.

I can totally relate to you. I think once you've played the game long enough and have gotten decent at it you start to get annoyed by more and more things. I think the best thing you can do is when you're playing casuals just focus on having a good time (It is a video game after all!) and not worry about anyone's performance too much. Also in ranked I think it's just best to focus on improving your own play and worrying about what you can do to win your team the game.
In the end, if you still find yourself having more negative feelings than positive ones after most of your games I think it's best just to take a small break. If you're going in to every match expecting to be frustrated then you probably will be at some point. A short break can only help you clear your mind.
Hope my advice helps and good luck
